name: Cain Firesong
summary: Cain Firesong is a Forsaken mage trainer located in the settlement of Brill within Tirisfal Glades. He assists fledgling practitioners of the arcane as they grow in power, guiding them before directing them onward to deeper studies in the Undercity. He can be found on the upstairs landing of the Gallows' End Tavern.

sections.title: A Practitioner in Brill
sections.body: While many Forsaken spellcasters delve into shadow or necromancy, Cain Firesong maintains mastery over traditional arcane disciplines. Stationed in Brill, he serves as an early mentor to Forsaken mages venturing forth from Deathknell. The local Deathguards direct visitors to the upstairs landing of the Gallows' End Tavern, joking that he arrived too late to get a room.

sections.title: Guiding New Talent
sections.body: As novice mages under his tutelage advance beyond their preliminary studies in Tirisfal Glades, Cain ensures they do not stagnate. He directs his most capable students to seek out Anastasia Hartwell, a master sorceress residing in the Magic Quarter of the Undercity.

faq.answer: Cain Firesong is a Forsaken mage trainer stationed in Brill in Tirisfal Glades. He teaches arcane spells to fledgling Horde spellcasters and directs advanced students toward the Undercity.

faq.q: Where does Cain Firesong stay in Brill?
faq.answer: Cain stands on the upstairs landing of the Gallows' End Tavern in Brill. Local Deathguards joke that he checked in too late to get a room.

faq.q: Where does Cain send mages after their initial training?
aliases: who does cain send mages to
faq.answer: Once a mage has advanced sufficiently under his guidance, Cain directs them to travel down into the Undercity's Magic Quarter to continue their instruction under Anastasia Hartwell.

angles.text: For young Forsaken mages stepping out from Deathknell, Cain Firesong is your primary mentor in Tirisfal Glades before you are summoned to the Undercity.
Cain proves that even in undeath, the arcane traditions of former human magi remain a potent weapon for the Forsaken.
